discrepancy_noted.description: TRUTH.openapi.yaml at /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-off/policies/{policyId} has a 'patch:' entry (iter15 LIVE-OVERRIDE). Code inspection and this live probe both confirm HTTP PUT is the actual verb sent by clockify_time_off_policies_update (Client.Put since at least commit 5c5e8ca). The iter15 probe log mislabeled the method as PATCH because the probe was recorded at the spec-comparison level (spec said PATCH) rather than confirmed at the HTTP-verb level. Clockify accepts PUT at this path.
